description: D22 void reference board. Player 0 plays Outmanoeuvre 1-for-2, (Moray,S) for {E,E}, then summons an E from Moray. Moray held no E before the card, so B* is void. Player 1's Outmanoeuvre is forced to 1-for-1 (no region holds two followers) and is NOT blocked, although it gives Moray [S], Strathclyde [E]: the board a clamped or physical-origin B* would have blocked.
